Proper scores from forecast samples

Source: R/eval-backtest.R
score_samples.Rd

Sample-based CRPS, weighted interval score (Bracher et al. 2021, with the 23 quantiles of the COVID-19 forecast hubs: 11 central intervals plus the median), interval coverage, PIT and the absolute error of the median.

Usage

score_samples(X, y, probs = wis_probs())

Arguments

X

Matrix of samples (one row per target).

y

Observed values.

probs

Quantile levels (must contain 0.5 and symmetric pairs).

Value

A data.table with median, mean, crps, wis, ae, cov50, cov80, cov95, pit.

References

Bracher J, Ray EL, Gneiting T, Reich NG (2021). Evaluating epidemic forecasts in an interval format. PLoS Computational Biology 17(2): e1008618. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1008618

Gneiting T, Raftery AE (2007). Strictly proper scoring rules, prediction, and estimation. Journal of the American Statistical Association 102(477): 359-378. doi:10.1198/016214506000001437
